text: TLDR; Pick’ Ems for Champs, penalties for stream sniping and instalock tools, and future changes to the Agent Gear system so make sure to grind it out and get all the items now! Heyo, it’s Ash and we’ve got a small-ish patch for you with mostly bug fixes. We’re prepping for a pretty beefy next patch in 13.06 so more to come! Let’s get it. ALL PLATFORMS COSMETICS UPDATES Sound Sprays Based on your feedback, we've adjusted the sound attenuation for all sound sprays so you'll only be able to hear the sounds if you're nearby to ensure teams can communicate effectively. This will be a standard for all future audio sprays. ESPORTS FEATURES Pick’Ems have returned for Champions Shanghai ! Starting on September 10, you will have access to the Group Stage in-client and on the web. Predict the advancing teams for points, earning extra points for correctly guessing the exact placement. You’ll also earn rewards just for participating. Get your picks in before Groups kickoff on September 24th! PLAYER BEHAVIOR UPDATES We've started rolling out penalties if we detect usage of stream sniping and instalock tools. Players found using these tools will be subject to temporary game bans that will escalate to permanent with repeated usage. PROGRESSION UPDATES Agent Gear Heads up, gamers! With the release of Patch 13.06 on September 22, we'll be revamping the Agent Gear system and the way you unlock items on that progression track. You will still keep the gear you've already earned, and you'll continue to use Kingdom Credits to unlock future gear. But after Patch 13.06, each piece of gear will be tied directly to how much you play the associated Agent. So if you're currently grinding for Agent Gear on any Agents you don't usually play, now's your chance to lock in and get those unlocks. BUG FIXES Agent General Fixed an issue where Agent Ultimate voiceover could continue playing from an enemy's perspective after the Agent casting the Ultimate was killed. Fixed an issue where the Combat Report incorrectly displayed "Enemies Blinded" for certain abilities that don't apply Blind. Fixed an issue where smokes would block flashes after dissipating. We’ve better timed the dissipation for the smokes on Astra, Brimstone, Clove, Miks, and Omen to fix an issue where their smokes could continue blocking flashes and other line-of-sight-dependent abilities while the smoke was dissipating. Chamber Fixed an issue that could cause performance drops the first time Chamber equipped, aimed, or fired Headhunter during a round. Cypher Fixed an issue where Cypher's Trapwire debuff could persist indefinitely on a new target if the initial target was killed just before the Trapwire triggered. Fixed an issue where Cypher's Cyber Cage could incorrectly block flashes, detection, and other line-of-sight-dependent abilities. Deadlock Fixed an issue where casting Deadlock's GravNet could briefly display unintended VFX on screen. Fade Fixed an issue where Fade's Seize would not display its danger indicator to enemies in certain locations on Lotus. KAY/O Fixed an issue where KAY/O's NULL/cmd could cause client-side framerate drops with each pulse. Omen Fixed an issue where Omen’s Dark Cover could obscure a player’s vision after the smoke has dissipated. Sage Fixed an issue where Sage's Healing Orb ability tooltips could be missing from the HUD when equipping the ability. Waylay Fixed an issue where vision-blocking abilities could prevent Waylay's Saturate from applying Hinder to players within its area of effect. Fixed an issue where Waylay's Refract could cause snapshots of dynamic map objects to remain visible after the ability ended. Fixed an issue where Waylay's Saturate could apply Hinder to Agents while they were intangible. PC ONLY GENERAL UPDATES Default Bot Count in Range Practice Mode An option for 10, 5, or 1 bot to spawn has been added in the Range practice mode. The default number of bots spawned is now 5. You can adjust this number in the Range settings. Fixed an issue where the close button was not functional after purchasing VALORANT Points.
title: VALORANT Patch Notes 13.05

text: Table of Contents Legend Buffs Conduit Fuse Catalyst Bloodhound Legend Nerfs Axle Seer Loot & Attachments Loot Spawning Weapons Attachments Locked Hop-Ups Maps Wildcard Ranked Audio Bug Fixes Legends Weapons Maps Engine Audio Quality of Life INTRO Welcome back to Split 2 of Apex Legends: Marked. To start the second half of the season, we’ve got Legend balancing changes, some adjustment to loot availability (including more healing items), buffs to a trio of long range weapons, and the usual array of tweaks, fixes and adjustments. Split 2 starts on September 15th, so assemble your squad and get ready to jump back into Marked! ANTI CHEAT UPDATE In the leadup to Split 2, we implemented significant, new systems to detect players using unauthorized controller hardware or software in Apex Legends on all platforms including: PC, PlayStation, Xbox, and Nintendo Switch 2. Prior to implementation, we spent several months thoroughly validating these systems to ensure they can accurately identify prohibited behavior. Players that trigger these detections will be actioned upon and may be banned accordingly upon review. Playing on console does not make you exempt from detection or enforcement. This is just the beginning for these new systems which we will continue to improve to keep pace with evolving cheating methods. We want the community to know that we are actively working to identify and remove cheaters at every level of play — including the highest ranks. Thank you to everyone who reports suspicious behavior and helps us keep Apex Legends fair. For more anti-cheat information, check out our most recent update ! PATCH NOTES LEGEND BUFFS Conduit Dev note: Our main goal is to give Conduit players more avenues for skill expression and to ensure her abilities feel functional, readable, and fluid. Apex’s Shield Healer saw a big uptick in her success throughout Season 29 thanks to some overhauls to her Tactical and its associated upgrades. Despite Conduit receiving a few nerfs since then, we still wanted to come back to her this Season to focus on polishing and refining her Ultimate, as mentioned in the Season 29 Designer’s Notes. Beyond her base kit, we wanted to give Conduit two brand new Level 2 Upgrades that are now fully unique to her and emphasize different aspects of her aggressive support style. Tactical Added preview visuals on the shield bar to indicate how much Temp Shield will be generated by the end of the regen period. Ultimate Various aspects of the Ultimate’s deployment have been smoothed out, meaning it fires faster and gets you back to guns sooner. Can now toggle orientation while targeting to deploy jammers in a forward line. Added a new HUD element to better inform players if their deployment location will cause jammers to break. Also, individual jammer indicators now turn red if they would break at the current targeting location. Jammers now spawn higher and slightly closer together, creating a tighter formation that covers more vertical space. Jammers activate significantly faster, establishing the barricade’s threat area quicker. Upgrades Both Level 2 Upgrades, Battpack and Bigger Jam, have been removed. NEW: Concurrency (Level 2) Refire Energy Barricade once with no cooldown within 10s of initial firing. Jammers spawn in a tighter formation with 2 less jammers. NEW: Jammed Up (Level 2) Energy Barricade’s jammers have a 25% larger radius and enemies damaged by them have their HUD jammed for 10s. Fuse Dev note: Though this grenadier has seen a gradual increase in play over time since his rework in Season 28, we wanted to revisit him to address the community feedback that we didn’t hit the efficacy, impact, and responsiveness expected of a new Motherlode. We’re also making some big shakeups to his Upgrade configuration that impact the rest of his kit, including incorporating Wreckless and Knuckle Cluster into his base kit (with some nerfs). Rest assured, we’ll be keeping a close eye on him, as our intention is to add more hype tech to Fuse’s toolbox without pushing him toward being a Legend defined by his movement. He will always be Apex’s explosives expert first and foremost! Passive Added 25% Explosive Damage Resistance at base and can see ordinances highlighted in the world within 30m of him. Tactical Fuse can now Knuckle Jump at base. Jumping no longer provides Tactical cooldown reduction. Jump power moderately decreased, so Fuse will gain less momentum when jumping. Now displays a visual indicator that signifies the radius where the jump can be activated. Significantly decreased the time it takes to return to guns after firing. Players can now ADS while aiming to zoom. Ultimate Slightly decreased the raise time. Adjusted the firing arc with the focus on the main explosive projectile landing more quickly and responsively. Added an indicator to visualize the radius of the initial and subsequent explosions. Decreased the time it takes for the mini-bombs to explode, speeding up the rollout of explosions. Decreased the damage falloff on the initial explosion, meaning enemies closer to the edge of the radius will take a higher percentage of the maximum damage. Upgrades Knuckle Jumper (Level 2) and Wreckless (Level 3) have been removed. Reignition has been moved from Level 3 to Level 2. Pyro Techniques (Level 2) Doubled the radius of the persistent flames. Reignition (Level 2) Decreased Ultimate Recharge Rate from 1s per 2 explosive damage to 1s per 3 explosive damage. NEW: Big Bang (Level 3) Knuckle Cluster’s explosions cover a 50% larger area. NEW: Sticky Bomb (Level 3) Knuckle Cluster’s initial projectile is 25% larger and sticks to enemies. Every 7 hits on an enemy reduces Knuckle Cluster’s cooldown by 1s. Catalyst Dev note: Catalyst saw a small boost in pick rate after her buffs in Season 28, but we felt she needed more love using a slightly different approach since her stats didn’t hold. This Season, we’re focusing more holistically on smoothing out the tension of moving from base to base amongst the fast pace of action. We want Cat’s building experience to be fun and flexible, so giving her more options to customize her space and adding in some longtime community-requested quality-of-life features will empower players to feel rewarded for putting in the work to master her. We’re also making big swings on shuffling up her upgrades, including a new Level 3 upgrade, Ferro-Frenzy, that will really shake up how we see players approach their setup. Passive Catalyst is no longer immune to other Catalysts’ abilities. Tactical Now automatically reinforces or rebuilds doors if colliding with a valid door or doorway on placement. Decreased Cooldown from 20s to 15s. Increased Spike Height, meaning that players can less easily jump over them. Hitting enemies with the projectile will now deal damage to them. Ultimate Significantly decreased firing time, making it smoother to deploy and raise the wall. Allies are no longer slowed or blinded when passing through the wall. Upgrades Sole Piercer (Level 2) has been removed. Hidden Spikes has been moved from Level 2 to Level 3. Resilient Veil and Ferro-Door have been moved from Level 3 to Level 2. Ferro-Door (Level 2) Now also increases max reinforced doors from 4 to 6. Resilient Veil (Level 2) Now also decreases Ultimate Cooldown from 150s to 120s. NEW: Ferro-Frenzy (Level 3) Your max Spike count is increased by 1. Spikes are 50% smaller, but deal faster tick damage. Bloodhound Dev note: Bloodhound got some significant changes for this season but they haven’t been as impactful on their pick and encounter win rates as we hoped. With these updates we’re hoping to add some improvements to their Ultimate and Tactical. We’ll continue to monitor Bloodhound’s performance and adjust if needed. From 8/‌25 Hotfix: Ultimate Reduced cloak visibility while in dome. Ring damage no longer drops cloak. Tactical Added 1 extra second on scan length. Tweaked to provide more frequent snapshots, but the snapshots fade over time. New: Tactical Sonar snapshots begin fading more quickly. Sonar snapshots should disappear more readily when seeing the head of either the snapshot or the player being tracked. Back to Top LEGEND NERFS Axle Dev note: For an ability with a short cooldown that can have a devastating effect on one target, the Kickstart drone needs more counterplay options. Even when the victim decides to destroy the drone, the high health pool often makes that hard to do, especially in close quarters when Axle is quickly following up, herself. For cases when destroying it isn’t an option, at least the victim should be able to have more agency about where they get displaced with the knockback nerf and decreased stun. From 8/‌25 Hotfix: Tactical Nitro Gate launch speed reduced from 750 to 700. Ultimate Ultimate HP reduced from 200 to 150. Base Ultimate cooldown increased from 90s to 120s. Ultimate knockback arc widened and max height reduced. Ultimate stun duration reduced from 1.5s to 0.25s. Upgrades Jump Gate replaced with a new Drone Deployer Upgrade that brings the Ult cooldown back down to 90s. Seer Dev note: The turn slow punishment on the Seer tactical was very frustrating to fight against. We’ve decided to remove the turn slow since the tactical output is still strong without it. From 8/‌25 Hotfix: Removed turn slow when hit by the Tactical Back to Top LOOT & ATTACHMENTS LOOT SPAWNING Dev Note: Last season, we made a huge change to loot distribution and spawning (read our retrospective in this update’s designer’s notes!). After reviewing the data and feedback from the community, we are making some minor adjustments to healing, ammo, and weapon availability. Healing was becoming scarcer than intended, and due to the removal of energy ammo, the other ammo types were spawning ammo boxes at higher rates than intended. text: Dear Operators, We plan to launch a non-stop update for PC, mobile, and console versions on September 8, opening the new season "Reorientation"! PC UPDATE CADENCE At 08:30 UTC+8 on September 8, Operations and Warfare ranked matches will be off-season and temporarily closed. At 09:59 UTC+8 on September 8, the Operations entrance and matchmaking mode will be closed, and the Market and Auction House functions will be disabled. At 10:00 UTC+8 on September 8, the PC update will be available. MOBILE UPDATE CADENCE At 08:30 UTC+8 on September 8, Operations and Warfare ranked matches will be off-season and temporarily closed. At 09:59 UTC+8 on September 8, the Operations entrance and matchmaking mode will be closed, and the Market and Auction House functions will be disabled. At 10:00 UTC+8 on September 8, the Android and iOS updates will be available. THE MAIN CONTENTS OF THE NEW SEASON ARE AS FOLLOWS: New Support Operator - Rover; Operations map refresh: Layali Grove; New Operations mode - Fishing; New Space City mode: Chieftain's Road - Polaris Patrol; New Warfare map: The Mog; brand-new 1v1 mode; new weapons, new ammo, plus extensive optimizations and balance adjustments! Full details on this season's update are below. Dive in! NEW SUPPORT OPERATOR: ROWAN WALSH, CODENAME ROVER MAN'S BEST FRIEND Blows the dog whistle to call in a military dog that fights alongside the operator. The dog continuously senses enemy targets within range: if enemies are present, it locks onto the nearest target and actively pursues, tackling them and applying a Mark; if no enemies are detected, it follows the operator and remains on Alert. DART RIFLE (OPERATIONS) Fires syringes. Upon impact, each syringe releases a lingering mist that continuously heals allies' injured limbs while reducing the max HP of enemies within range and dealing damage over time. DART RIFLE (WARFARE) Fires syringes. Upon impact, each syringe releases a lingering mist that reduces the max HP of enemies within range and deals damage over time. IRRITANT Throws an Irritant Smoke Grenade; enemies within the smoke will cough. GUARD DRIVE (OPERATIONS) Enemies hit by his gadgets become easier for his military dog to track. Grants longer downed durations, and rescuing an ally removes multiple stacks of limb injuries. PREY DRIVE (OPERATIONS) Enemies hit by his gadget become easier for his military dog to track. Rescuing an ally resupplies their ammo. MAP UPDATES OPERATIONS MAP REFRESH - LAYALI GROVE 2.0 Scene Changes: Added Serenity Bay, North Slope Caves, and the Haavk Underground Dock, among other areas; Expanded the map boundaries, and optimized and connected the overall river network; Adjusted cover structures in certain areas. Mode Update: Added a new Flagship Task, "Bounty: Wave Breaker": steal and escort an Assault Boat hidden in the Haavk Underground Dock for Reis, then extract it for rewards; the Assault Boat remains usable after the mission is complete; Added a new vehicle gameplay feature: in addition to the Assault Boat, four Jet Skis have been added to the map, drivable across all river areas on the map; when "Bounty: Wave Breaker" is not active, two additional Jet Skis will spawn; Added a new NPC gameplay feature: encounter new NPCs "Joe Reed," "Zola Zar," and "Taj Faris" on the map. Interact with them, and unexpected stories may unfold. Other Optimizations: Redesigned and adjusted the Insertion Point locations at Layali Grove; Removed the blocked-off area inside Haavk WSR Lab. Adjusted the extraction rules for the train extraction point at Transnova Station: the door opens 1 minute after pulling the lever, with extraction available 3 minutes later (previously 5 minutes); Added new supply containers and supply spawn points; Due to the map scene upgrade, optimized and adjusted the distribution of certain supplies; Optimized and adjusted unbalanced positions on the map. NEW WARFARE MAP - THE MOG Event Description: The brand-new map "The Mog" has arrived! Return to a classic, smoke-filled battlefield and wage intense infantry street warfare through the crumbling districts of modern Mogadishu! Experience all-new push-cart tug-of-war battles and UH-60 Black Hawk suppressive air support, and launch epic combined-arms map warfare. NEW MODES POLARIS PATROL Mode available starting: October 16 Gameplay: In Polaris Patrol mode, choose to play as either Desmoulins or the Adjutant. After selecting your identity, your appearance and abilities will switch accordingly. Upon entering a match, your role switches to Desmoulins or the Adjutant, granting you all-new abilities to fight off the invaders. Squad Desmoulins also has exclusive in-match gameplay. Friendly Haavk units will remain neutral toward Squad Desmoulins (excluding Hudson units); Results are calculated based on operation performance, earning Performance Points. Increasing your Performance Rank grants exclusive Director's supplies and limited appearances. Director's Reward Crates have a chance to contain limited red-quality collectibles. Completing Director's and Adjutant's to-do missions grants Performance Points; complete all missions to earn an exclusive Medal of Honor. Unlike Fiery Owl Hunt, in this Polaris Patrol event, G.T.I. Operators can also earn Performance Points by defeating Squad Desmoulins in a match. G.T.I. Operators who defeat Desmoulins have a chance to find limited red-quality collectibles in his mezzanine. Identity Requirements Security Director Desmoulins: Complete the Desmoulins File to unlock the Desmoulins identity. Entering as Desmoulins requires spending a Security Director's Work Badge. Desmoulins can enter solo or team up with an Adjutant. Adjutant: Adjutants include the Heavy Guard and Comms Guard, unlocked by default, requiring no Security Director's Work Badge to enter. A Desmoulins must be present in the squad for an Adjutant to enter. Squad Desmoulins Loadouts: Can manually configure loadouts or use Gear Tickets and exclusive Custom Gear Tickets. Special access: Desmoulins can use the executive elevator and its exclusive extraction point in the Space City garden. After the G.T.I. faction kills Desmoulins, they can pick up his special Access Card in the mezzanine sector to use the aforementioned exclusive access. Security Director's Work Badges can be purchased from the Supply Station for 250,000 Tekniq Alloys each. You can initially purchase 4, with one additional purchase slot restored every 21 hours, up to a maximum of 8 stored. Desmoulin's Squad Ability Overview Security Director - Anais Desmoulins Tactical Gear: Neural-Controlled Vehicle Deploys and controls a Haavk cutting-edge Neural-Controlled Vehicle for remote combat operations. The vehicle is equipped with a multi-function Weapon Station, featuring combat modules such as an MG, Grenade Launcher, Threat Imaging System, and Seeker Bomb Vehicle. Tactical Gear: Threat Imaging System Activates her imaging system to scan and mark nearby threats, and share target data with squadmates. While active, gains increased handling and ADS movement speed based on her equipped weapon, along with additional buffs. When in a vehicle, she can lock onto enemy targets, enabling lock-on for certain vehicle weapons. Tactical Gear: Seeker Bomb Vehicle Deploys a Seeker Bomb Vehicle that moves forward, searching for enemies. Upon detecting a target, it automatically locks on, pursues the target, and detonates after a short delay. Weakness Analysis Desmoulins applies a lasting Weakness effect to enemies hit. Affected targets have reduced armor repair speed and slower use of certain medical items, increasing recovery time. If a target enters the Dying state, their Bleed Rate increases and their mobility while Downed is reduced. Adjutant - Athos Leal Tactical Gear: Remote Bomb Throws a remote bomb that can be manually detonated after attaching, or detonates automatically after a longer delay. It can attach to the Neural-Controlled Vehicle, greatly extending the automatic detonation timer while attached. Tactical Gear: Smoke Grenade Fires a smoke grenade that bursts on impact. The grenade can attach to the Neural-Controlled Vehicle, continuously releasing smoke from the attachment point for a set duration. Operator Trait: Haavk Elite Drags allies to safety. When the Adjutant is near Desmoulins or the Neural-Controlled Vehicle, direct damage dealt by either one to an enemy operator briefly increases the Adjutant's movement speed. Adjutant - Aramis Orgueil Tactical Gear: Flare Fires a flare that hovers in place after traveling a set distance, periodically scanning for enemy operators. The flare can attach to the Neural-Controlled Vehicle and periodically scan from the attachment point. Tactical Gear: Airburst Grenade Fires an airburst grenade that detonates after a fixed delay, dealing damage. The grenade can attach to the Neural-Controlled Vehicle without changing its detonation delay. Operator Trait: Haavk Elite Drags allies to safety. When the Adjutant is near Desmoulins or the Neural-Controlled Vehicle, direct damage dealt by either one to an enemy operator briefly increases the Adjutant's movement speed. Available Operations and Difficulty Normal Operation: Space City - Normal, AZ3 - Normal; Hard Operation: Space City - Hard. Gameplay Rewards Increasing your Performance Rank grants rewards upon leveling up, with exclusive rewards including: Desmoulins Reward Crate: Chance to obtain the red-quality Petite Madame or red-quality Requin Model; once both Petite Madame and Requin Model are collected, they can be assembled into the Petite Madame - Requin Model. The Petite Madame - Requin Model can be placed in your EDC Tool Kit and brought into matches; Desmoulins Exclusive Weapon Appearance: [M700 Sniper Rifle] - Serenity; M700 Sniper Rifle Exclusive Attachment: HVK Whirlwind Enhanced Gas Block: Craftable once Polaris Patrol reaches the Hunter stage, limited to 10 per week; Desmoulins Exclusive Cosmetic Rewards: Desmoulins Avatar, Spray Paint, Calling Card,

text: OPENING DAY // CHAMPIONS SHANGHAI Champions Shanghai starts way before the first bullet is fired. Forget what you know about Opening Day. This year we’re taking our city-wide collision of culture, community, and competition in China directly to your screen, no matter where you are in the world. If you aren’t dialed in from the very first minute on September 24 at 1:00am PDT (4:00pm CST), you’re missing out on the most ambitious, chaotic, and beautiful Champions opening we’ve ever built. WHAT TO EXPECT This year’s opening day is bigger than any single stage, so we’re taking you beyond the arena. Opening Day Segments : Segments all across a city that lives and breathes VALORANT Champions. Join us at Pop Mart, Hai Di Lao, DOE, Artist Alley, the VALORANT Concept PC Bang, and on the streets of Shanghai. MEET THE TALENT Hosts & Creators: TenZ Sacy TcK MeL Loupiote Spicyuuu SiuFatBB HOW TO WATCH Mark your calendars and be there before the starting bell. trust. Date : September 24 Start Time : 1:00am PDT, 4:00pm CST Where to Watch : Tune in via the official VALORANT channels. It’s the biggest stage. The biggest event. The biggest VALORANT Champions celebration in history. We’ll see you in Shanghai.
